audited.name: Allgaeuer Kraftwerke GmbH
audited.result: Current first-party AllgaeuStrom/AUEW tariff matrix, valid from 2026-04-13, now establishes the operator's current anonymous ad-hoc tariff classes and fee components: AC tariff zones I and II 0.51 EUR/kWh with 1.00 EUR start fee; AC zone I blocking 0.05 EUR/min after 180 min between 07:00-22:00, AC zone II no blocking fee; DC <=50 kW 0.57 EUR/kWh, no start fee, blocking 0.06 EUR/min after 180 min between 07:00-22:00; DC >50 kW 0.66 EUR/kWh, no start fee, blocking 0.10 EUR/min after 45 min. Credit-card ad-hoc activation is explicitly first-party. This materially upgrades tariff-policy evidence but does not by itself assign each residual EVSE to an AC tariff zone, so the CPO remains partial until residual EVSE-to-zone/power mapping is exact.
audited.nextAction: Map each residual EVSE to AC zone I/II or DC power class; once all residual points are mapped, promote without inferring zone membership.

audited.name: Stadtwerke Leipzig GmbH
audited.result: Fresh first-party Leipzig evidence confirms ad-hoc access remains available through the station QR flow and identifies the public ad-hoc frontend. Current first-party L-Strom.drive prices valid from 2026-01-01 are 0.54 EUR/kWh AC and 0.64 EUR/kWh DC for the registered regular tariff, while a current secondary report explicitly based on Stadtwerke information gives distinct ad-hoc prices of 0.65 EUR/kWh AC and 0.75 EUR/kWh DC from 2026-01-01. A BNetzA-derived station record confirms a new 4x400 kW Stadtwerke Leipzig site at P+R Neue Messe entered service 2026-01-14 and supports direct terminal/app/website payment. This proves post-2024 infrastructure exists and gives strong current ad-hoc tariff evidence, but the CPO stays partial until the post-2024 EVSE set is exhaustively enumerated and the ad-hoc values are tied to those EVSEs/checkout surfaces or confirmed first-party as universally applicable.
audited.nextAction: Enumerate Stadtwerke Leipzig EVSEs commissioned after 2024-04-13 from BNetzA/Mobilithek and bind direct-payment evidence per site; do not substitute registered L-Strom.drive prices for ad-hoc.

consistencyCheck.repeatInvestigationGuard: PASS: both targets gained new decisive evidence dimensions (first-party Allgaeu tariff-class matrix; Leipzig current ad-hoc flow plus a newly commissioned 2026 BNetzA-derived site).
consistencyCheck.materialProgress: Allgaeu tariff policy is now first-party complete by tariff class; Leipzig post-2024 existence and current ad-hoc tariff distinction are verified.

nextSafeAction: Finish Allgaeuer residual EVSE-to-zone mapping first, then enumerate Leipzig post-2024 EVSEs. Keep GEW/Goettingen dormant absent new fee-completeness evidence.
